page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top, a centred psalm heading, verse lines in italic, and FINIS centred at the bottom. No margin notes.

main_text.p: decepti falsa, nec præpediti superba ac pertinaci non recedendi ab erroribus assuetis præjudiciisque amatis voluntate, qua omne malum concluditur. Ad quæ omnia ut sequentes de Eruditione Libri aliquid conferre possint, concedat ille Optimus Maximus, cujus Nomen sit benedictum in secula!
main_text.head: PSALM. XIX.

p.i:
Errata mentis quis meminit vagæ?
Quæ deprehendet vis Sapientiæ?
Ergo repurga quas refudit
Clam maculas sinuosus error.
Fac regna cordis ne sibi vendicet
Vis impotentis dira Superbiæ.
Sic me malorum e maximorum
Compedibus facile explicabis.
Quæ lingua fundit verba, quod in sinu
Secum volutat mens tacito, accipe
Placatus, o nostræ Salutis
Ars, Dominus, Deus & Redemptor!

page.notes: The ink blot at the right of the first paragraph covers a few letters ("omne", "fe"); read as printed. The verse lines are set as one stanza. The heading "PSALM. XIX." is set in small capitals. Faint watermark-style text at the lower right corner is a digitiser's mark and is omitted.
